God is a ♥♥♥♥♥

This game is just some fantastic, casual ultra violence where you get to drop napalm and other high explosive ♥♥♥♥ you upon giant space bugs, space frogs, and stereotypical grey 1950s aliens of all varieties. There's also some stuff in there about jet pack lasers and power armor jack hammers, but I've been an Air Raider main for most of my play time. The campaign is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ long, too, so you get more than enough play time out of just a single play through on a single difficulty setting with something ~150 (edit: it's 111, my bad, unless there are more added by completing higher difficulties) missions ranging from short "Hey just kill this little group of bugs" all the way to basically fighting at the beaches of Normandy, except your the allies fighting aliens bringing every last ounce of manpower they have to bear, traversing whole mountain ranges and cityscapes to mop up every last poor ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ that decided to show up to work that day. The dialogue is also disgustingly cheesey, but it gives it so much charm. Also don't surprise if you run into dud weapons that are really crap and just generally unusable. They're rare, but they exist. There are also some weapons and equipment that are extremely fun but also generally impractical, but fun is the first word in this game's dictionary and it's not afraid to just keep throwing ♥♥♥♥ at the wall until enough of it sticks. My only problem with the game is it can get pretty grindy as it goes on, just re-playing the same maps with different objectives and enemy sets and some of the enemy times being VERY sponge-y, but there's still so much satisfaction that it's really more of a nit pick. Buy it. Play it. Why are you reading this instead of doing that? I was also gifted this game, but trust me, if you've been sitting on the EDF series, or just this game, this is the perfect time to get into it cause it seems like this game is kind of a series reboot of some kind cause they act like this is the first time aliens have ever shown up so you don't really need any knowledge of prior games to follow along.
